requirements.title: DNS service SVCB name formation
requirements.statement: SVCB record names (QNAMEs) for DNS services MUST be formed using Port Prefix Naming with the scheme "dns".

requirements.title: Authentication name format
requirements.statement: The authentication name MUST be a DNS hostname or a literal IP address.

requirements.title: Default DNS port for unencrypted UDP/TCP
requirements.statement: When connecting to the service using unencrypted DNS over UDP or TCP, clients MUST use port 53.

requirements.title: Non-default port prefix naming
requirements.statement: When the binding authority specifies a non-default port number, Port Prefix Naming MUST place the port number in an additional prefix on the name.

requirements.title: Treat records as incompatible when ALPN is absent
requirements.statement: If the "alpn" SvcParamKey is absent, the client MUST treat the SVCB record as "incompatible" unless some other recognized SvcParam indicates a supported protocol.

requirements.title: Require dohpath when HTTP versions are present
requirements.statement: If the protocol set contains any HTTP versions (e.g., "h2", "h3"), the "dohpath" key MUST be present.

requirements.title: HTTPS record keys apply to the resulting HTTP connection
requirements.statement: All SvcParamKeys specified for use with the HTTPS record MUST be permissible and apply to the resulting HTTP connection.

requirements.title: Separate protocols with different default ports when no port is specified
requirements.statement: If the protocol set contains protocols with different default ports and no "port" key is specified, a client MUST contact the protocols separately on their respective default ports.

requirements.title: Use default ports when omitted
requirements.statement: If omitted, the client SHALL use the default port number for each transport protocol (853 for DoT and DoQ, 443 for DoH).

requirements.title: Ignore records containing unsupported port keys
requirements.statement: A client that does not respect the "port" key MUST ignore any SVCB record that contains this key.

requirements.title: Define dohpath as a single-valued UTF-8 relative URI template
requirements.statement: The single-valued `dohpath` SvcParamKey MUST have a value that is a relative URI Template encoded in UTF-8.
notes: Trimmed the value constraint to one testable clause and kept the source trace.

requirements.title: Require dohpath when ALPN indicates HTTP
requirements.statement: If the `alpn` SvcParam indicates HTTP support, `dohpath` MUST be present.
notes: Trimmed the wording while preserving the presence requirement and trace.

requirements.title: Require a dns variable in the URI Template
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST contain a `dns` variable.

requirements.title: Require valid :path expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST expand to a valid and functional `:path` value.

requirements.title: Send DoH requests to the HTTPS origin from the SVCB record
requirements.statement: When using this SVCB record, the client MUST send DoH requests to the HTTPS origin identified by the `https` scheme, the authentication name, and the port from the `port` SvcParam if present.
notes: Trimmed the request-origin wording and normalized the trace refs.

requirements.title: Direct HTTP requests to the dohpath expansion resource
requirements.statement: HTTP requests MUST be directed to the resource produced by expanding the `dohpath` URI Template.
notes: Trimmed the target description to the expansion-produced resource.

requirements.title: Avoid querying HTTPS RRs when using dohpath
requirements.statement: Clients SHOULD NOT query HTTPS RRs when using `dohpath`.
notes: Kept the negative query rule as a standalone advisory requirement.

requirements.title: Use the SVCB SvcParams and address records for HTTPS connections
requirements.statement: The SvcParams and address records associated with this SVCB record SHOULD be used for the HTTPS connection.
notes: Trimmed the connection-use wording to the implementation-relevant core.

requirements.title: Publish an equivalent HTTPS RR
requirements.statement: Service operators SHOULD publish an equivalent HTTPS RR.
notes: Removed the rationale clause and kept the publication recommendation.

requirements.title: Avoid AliasMode records when resolution speed is high
requirements.statement: Where resolution speed is a high priority, AliasMode records SHOULD be avoided.

requirements.title: Follow the TargetName convention when resolution speed is high
requirements.statement: Where resolution speed is a high priority, the SVCB TargetName SHOULD follow the convention described in Section 10.2 of [SVCB].

requirements.title: Authenticate to the server's authentication name
requirements.statement: During secure transport establishment, clients MUST authenticate the server to its authentication name.
notes: Trimmed to the testable invariant while preserving the referenced source unit.

requirements.title: Do not identify or authenticate during DNS queries
requirements.statement: A client of this SVCB mapping MUST NOT identify or authenticate itself when performing DNS queries, except to servers that it specifically knows are not vulnerable to such attacks.

requirements.title: Avoid further queries after an invalid response
requirements.statement: If an endpoint sends an invalid response to a DNS query, the client SHOULD NOT send more queries to that endpoint.

requirements.title: Optionally log invalid DNS query responses
requirements.statement: If an endpoint sends an invalid response to a DNS query, the client MAY log this error.

requirements.title: Prefer SVCB-reliant behavior after successful resolution
requirements.statement: If use of this specification is optional, clients SHOULD switch to SVCB-reliant behavior when SVCB resolution succeeds.
notes: Trimmed wording while preserving the same advisory invariant.

requirements.title: Allow dependent specifications to adjust fallback behavior
requirements.statement: Specifications making use of this mapping MAY adjust this fallback behavior to suit their requirements.
notes: Kept as a narrow dependency-scoped allowance; trace cleaned to the reviewed source unit.

requirements.title: Register the dohpath IANA entry
requirements.statement: IANA MUST register number 7 as `dohpath` for the DNS-over-HTTPS path template.

requirements.title: Register the _dns node name
requirements.statement: IANA MUST register `_dns` as the node name for SVCB.

requirements.title: Assign the RR type SVCB
requirements.statement: The RR type MUST be `SVCB` (64).

requirements.title: Discourage cleartext fallback
requirements.statement: Cleartext fallback SHOULD NOT be used.

requirements.title: Make port mandatory
requirements.statement: The `port` key MUST be automatically mandatory.

requirements.title: Map the scheme to dns
requirements.statement: The mapped scheme MUST be `dns`.

requirements.title: Override HTTPS RR for DoH
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST override the HTTPS RR for DoH.

requirements.title: Require alpn or equivalent
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST require `alpn` or an equivalent key.

requirements.title: Set the name prefix by port
requirements.statement: The name prefix MUST be `_dns` for port 53 and `_$PORT._dns` otherwise.

requirements.title: Support HTTPS SvcParamKeys
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST support all HTTPS RR SvcParamKeys.

requirements.title: Use a per-transport default port
requirements.statement: The default port MUST be per-transport.
